description: Bounty: Hard Case: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Orrin Hask does not run. {client} would rather he did not stay either.
Hask is in {system} with a full wing. He will fight you.
Bounty on Orrin Hask. Expect a stand-up fight.
success: Hask is down. {client} is pleased and says so, briefly.
Bounty collected. Hask's wing is scattered.
Orrin Hask is finished. Good shooting.
failure: Hask held the field. The bounty stands.
You are driven off. Hask goes back to work.
radio-hunt: Hask is turning in to meet you. Three wingmen.
He wants the fight. Give him one.
Target engaging. Keep your nose on the gunship.
radio-heavy: Four more, far side. Gunships among them.
Hask had a reserve. Watch for bombers.
